script-source.value: async function main(){const started=Date.now();let clickedAt;const operations=await Promise.allSettled([page.getByText('THIS_STATUS_NEVER_EXISTS',{exact:true}).waitFor({timeout:1200}),page.locator('#redraw').click({timeout:600}).then(()=>{clickedAt=Date.now()-started})]);return {elapsed:Date.now()-started,clickedAt,operations:operations.map(x=>({status:x.status,code:x.reason?.code})),counts:await page.locator('#counts').textContent()}}
